notes: Component tier is edge-less in v1 (Decision 2b): the sys→comp fallback edges live in @m3e/web dist CSS (var(--m3e-*, var(--md-sys-*))), not in the CEM. Component nodes are leaves; the L6 detector still catches new/renamed component vars via the regenerate-and-diff drift gate.
Per-component density minScale is not modeled in v1 (Decision 5a): the clamp lives in @m3e/web dist DensityToken. The density family carries the uniform measured domain + base unit only.
